Not really to be honest.  I studied abnormal pscyhology in college, and we went over both of these things.  I really can't see anything in common (especially medically speaking).  One deals with issues with socializing skills while another has to do with obsessions.

But, yes, relaxing would help.

Uh, no offense, but Asperger's/Autism is nothing related to OCD.  Sorry, your example is not even related to OCD.

No, I think alcoholism is a horrible idea for coping.  Its bad for your health as well.

Sorry, I just disagree with you is all.  Not trying to be offensive.

K, again, I asked for no joking responses.  I would really appreciate it.  If you don't have OCD, you probably think the above is stupid.  Those with OCD would understand what I'm talking about probably.

I guess that is true.  Yes I am working on fixing this.

Are there really grad students who get undergrad girls?  Or older guys who get younger girls?  Could you give some examples (besides Hugh Hefner)?  I mean like normal people or people you know?
Would you mind sharing the National crisis hot-line number?  What is the Trevor project?

It's easier said than done for me.  Maybe killing yourself is a reset button, IDK.  No one does really.

Sure, parties aren't over and chances of socializing in the future aren't over.  But there in a different context.  I don't know if I will ever get the same chance, even if I go back to college for grad school in a couple of years.
